name: Ogre Battlecaster — gets +X/+0, X = the cast spell's mana value, entered on the trigger
notes: Sweep group 4 (2026-10-07). A number read off a card that is not on the battlefield is asked for as X on the fired ability (the "where X is …" clause is cut from the fired text and the ability gets an X input, saved with the board). "When you cast that spell, this creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is that spell's mana value." parsed to nothing. X = 3: Ogre Battlecaster 6/3; the bystander is untouched.
